exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: activity.duration_filter: {"comparator":">","value":3,"unit":"minutes","wording_status":"question section says example; evaluation applies it"}

inputBoundary: One already-segmented physical-activity log occurrence with a finite nonnegative duration expressed in minutes.
outputBoundary: Exclude the occurrence at or below three minutes and retain it only when duration is strictly greater than three minutes; equality is excluded.
limitations: This binding does not collect or parse the source physical-activity log.
This binding does not segment activity observations into occurrences or derive occurrence duration.
This binding does not infer activity type or interpret the logged confidence level.
This binding does not construct the last-24-hour challenge-question answer set or choose distractors.
This binding does not aggregate retained occurrences into daily evaluation statistics or authentication features.
A missing, non-finite, or negative occurrence duration fails closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
